name: Harumichi no Tsuraki
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 32); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 864.

poems.title: The stormy winds of yesterday
poems.author: Harumichi no Tsuraki
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 32
poems.text:
The stormy winds of yesterday
The maple branches shook;
And see! a mass of crimson leaves
Has lodged within that nook,
And choked the mountain brook.

poems.title: 32. 山がはに 風のかけたる しがらみは (Yamagawa ni kaze no kaketaru shigarami wa)
poems.author: Harumichi no Tsuraki
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 古今集
poems.text:
山がはに 風のかけたる しがらみは
流れもあへぬ 紅葉なりけり
